root_idea.summary: The root centers on freedom from admixture: clarity, purity, and the extraction of what is clear or choice.
root_idea.development: From physical clarity and smoothness, the root develops meanings of taking the pure or best portion, selecting or singling out, reciprocal sincerity, and several specialized terms for abundance, cessation, and smooth stone.

senses.definition: To choose or single someone out in preference to others for something.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive construction with the person chosen and the thing or distinction assigned to that person; the Quranic occurrences express being chosen for or given a particular distinction.

senses.definition: To select, single out, or prefer; to designate someone or something as chosen.
senses.usage_conditions: In divine selection, the selection may be understood as bringing the chosen one into being free from admixture or as choosing and judging in preference to others. The form may take a person, group, or thing as its object and may occur with عَلَى to mark preference.

senses.definition: A smooth, hard stone or rock; also a collective term for smooth stones.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun denotes a smooth rock or stony surface, characterized by hardness and freedom from material that clings to it.
The supplied Quran occurrence is a masculine plural inflection, presented here under the singular passive-participle citation form.

senses.definition: Purified, clarified, or cleared of admixture and impurities.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle describing something after particles, turbidity, or other admixture have been removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become clear, limpid, or pure, especially of wine, water, a beverage, or a thing; also to become free of cloud or turbidity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is also used figuratively of life, the mind, the heart, and affection when they are free from disturbance or admixture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, ewe, or she-goat: to abound in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized use applied to female livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the clear, pure, best, or choice portion of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be used of taking the clear part from a cooking-pot; the corresponding nouns denote the clear or choice portion of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clearness, limpidness, or purity; the state of being free from turbidity or admixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the abstract noun corresponding to physical or figurative clarity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear, limpid, or pure; free from turbidity or rust, and by extension bright or clean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may describe a substance, atmosphere, pasture free of dried rubbish, a colour, or a sword; the feminine form is also used substantively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To winnow a heap of trodden-out grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active Form II use involving removal of unwanted material from grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To behave toward one another with purity and sincerity of mind, love, affection, or brotherly feeling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These reciprocal forms describe mutual sincerity and are synonymous with reciprocal forms built on خَلَصَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing belong exclusively to someone, or to assign or appropriate it purely to that person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This transitive use focuses on exclusive assignment rather than merely choosing among alternatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To content or satisfy a household with something little or scanty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV use with a household as the recipient and a small provision as the means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a ruler or governor: to take what is in a person's house, or to take all that person's property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional appropriation or seizure use, distinct from ordinary selection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become destitute or devoid of property, education, or polite accomplishments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive figurative use, construed with مِنْ for what one has become devoid of.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man: to become exhausted of semen through sexual intercourse, or to cease sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use connected with sexual activity and its cessation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a hen: to cease laying eggs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is explained metaphorically as becoming clear or emptied of eggs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a poet: to cease composing or uttering poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intransitive use modeled on the cessation of eggs or the reaching of bare stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people: to have abundant milk in their camels and sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is a group whose livestock is producing plentiful milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a digger: to reach stone that prevents or stops further digging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is used of reaching صَفًا, understood as hard stone or rock forming an obstacle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cleared or clarified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V development of the basic clarity meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or reckon a thing as clear, limpid, or pure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical use of Form VIII focusing on taking the pure portion or treating something as purified, distinct from selecting a person or thing in preference to others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chosen or elect person; a choice one or favourite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can describe a person regarded as the choice one among others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In idiomatic expressions, a hard or unreceptive person from whom no good is obtained; also, to assail or impugn someone's character.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are conventional figurative applications of the unyielding smooth-stone image.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An echo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare idiomatic interpretation attributed in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named place in Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: As a place-name, the word may be treated as masculine or feminine according to whether it denotes the place or the location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small quantity of water or wine in a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression فِي الإِنَاءِ صِفْوَةٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ or خَمْرٍ, the noun denotes a small amount rather than the pure portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clear, very cold day without clouds or atmospheric thickness; also a named cold day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: صَفْوَانُ is used for the second of the cold days and صُفَيَّةُ for the first in the cited naming tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain fish, traditionally said to chew the cud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun, with the plural صَوَافٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported Quranic variant reading, animals regarded as belonging purely or exclusively to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an alternative reading reported for the passage conventionally cited by Lane as Kur. xxii. 37; the cited notation is not converted here into a modern verse location, and the reading is not a canonical QAC form in this packet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property, towns, or lands appropriated exclusively by a ruler for specially favoured persons, or possessions left without owners or heirs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive plural usage in administrative and political vocabulary; the cited authorities give more than one account of the exact legal scope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The portion of spoil chosen by a chief or commander for himself before or apart from the general division.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to a specially selected indivisible or choice item; its plural is صَفَايَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel, ewe, or she-goat abounding in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective can also denote a she-camel whose milk continues throughout the year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm-tree abounding in fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use of the adjective, with the same plural pattern reported for the livestock sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strainer or clarifying implement used to effect the removal of impurities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is identified with a رَاوُوق and has the plural مَصَافٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In later or modern usage, serenity, freedom from trouble, contentment, happiness, or pleasure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a later figurative extension rather than the basic physical sense of clarity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A friend who regards another with reciprocal purity or sincerity of love, affection, or brotherly feeling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun or adjective for a person standing in such a sincere friendship; the plural is أَصْفِيَاءُ.
